headline: Skyward says go around
lede: The runway stopped splatting its own students. A hot-but-shallow arrival now bounces with a `TOO HOT — GO AROUND` banner, straight rollouts pay +100 onto the ✈ badge, and a scuff gauge warns you before the deck decides — the wheels-down tail #3331 asked for, shipped in one stage.

notes.text: Go-around law: hot, shallow, straight on the strip = bounce, no crash, nothing banked; steep/crabbed/off-strip arrivals keep the old crash byte-identical.
CLEAN ROLL — CENTRELINE +100: 12 m rolled inside the dash banks onto the ✈ best (badge-only; licence math and the replay hash untouched).
skywardcheck 158/158 with 52/52 mutants die — one mutant caught an inverted assertion in a first-draft pin before it could bless a broken law.
Live proof at 1280 and 390: bounce banner, scuff gauge climbing to 0.9, ✈800 clean roll, every new string fit-audited at phone width.
